verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents `pulumi preview`, which shows planned changes without applying them, and CLI exit codes intended for scripts and CI/CD systems. A community user reports running Pulumi in the CI/CD pipeline of every microservice, and Automation API offers programmatic, non-CLI execution. That covers non-interactive plan/apply in CI, but nothing in the evidence shows saving a plan as an artifact and applying exactly that plan, or approval flags such as auto-approve or skip-confirmation. Missing for 10: documented saved plan artifacts consumed by apply, documented non-interactive approval flags, and hands-on corroboration of a gated preview-then-apply CI workflow.
